About Me

Over 3 years in the product design industry, I’ve learned that the best design decisions start with evidence. I’m a design researcher and strategic designer, currently completing a Master’s in Strategic Design Management at NID. Focusing on human centered approach I start with the people involved, map how the system really works, and design the move that closes the gap between what’s promised and what actually happens.
